title: Implement and ship the frozen mitosis testing-architecture SPEC

completion_criteria.text: M1: run-store gains recordDispatch persisting each dispatch's structured response to dispatches.jsonl, with the four preserved 2026-08-21 scratch directories copied into the repository first.
M2: cassette.mjs exports loadCassette, scriptFor and CASSETTE_SCHEMA, rejecting all five invalid shapes named in the SPEC including a recorded cassette carrying a null sourceRun.
M3: buildStubDispatch takes a cassette argument; unset leaves smoke byte-identical to trunk, a two-reject cassette yields three plan-review dispatches, and exhaustion emits cassette-exhausted.
M4: all ten state and transition scenarios run from full-e2e-sweep.sh with per-scenario exit codes, and row 8, the built unit dropped on resume, is proven red on the parent and green after.
M5: the prompt side-effect harness executes every shell command the implement prompt instructs inside a trailing-slash gitignore fixture, and is confirmed red at 05b29b5e before being called correct.
M6: every mitosis test file carries a bucket and a reason; a decoration file is deleted only where its behaviour is covered elsewhere, and each withheld deletion is filed with the coverage it holds.
Green the trunk and land the stranded sweep: the two census guards main fails are fixed and pull request 277's swallowed content is cherry-picked forward, in one pull request against main.
M7: each of the five named failure branches carries a test that reddens when that branch is deleted, with the assertion quoted, or is filed as an explicit gap naming the branch.
Make the recorder see the planning phase: PR 279 merges, the primary checkout fast-forwards past it, and recordDispatch is confirmed present in the live run-store.mjs before any money is spent.
M8: one billed single-lane run harvests cassettes with provenance recorded and a sourceRun, and the M4 sweep re-runs against them with any outcome difference reported as a finding.

spine.active_goal: Close the instrument so a green pipeline proves mitosis works live, then finish M8 as the proof run.
spine.next_step: Three steps, the first two human. 1: merge PR 279, whose CI is clean at 3203 tests and 3200 pass, its one failure being the node_modules defect already red on main. 2: fast-forward the primary checkout with merge --ff-only origin/main; safe, since no incoming commit touches the eight dirty documentation files. 3: then M8, which runs the single billed lane, harvests cassettes carrying provenance and a sourceRun, and re-runs the M4 sweep against them.
spine.last_session: Verified 278 landed by content parity, not ancestry. Proved the trunk carries one real failure, not fifteen. Closed M7 as evidence with no repository change. Found the recorder blind to planning before any money was spent, and opened PR 279 to fix it.

open_risks.text: Read this suite's verdict from CI rather than any local run — the primary checkout is the only honest local reader, a fresh clone adds fourteen false failures, and a linked worktree censuses an empty set
Leave the test job off the required checks until the node_modules trailing-slash defect is fixed — it is genuinely red on main today, so requiring it would block every pull request
Fast-forward the primary checkout before any billed run — the harness reads the engine from there, and recordDispatch is absent from its working tree, so a run today would record nothing
Read a pull request's checks yourself before merging it — the test job is not a required status check here, so GitHub will merge a red pull request on a single click
Treat teardown's unbounded directory removal as live — it deleted a directory outside the repository and returned success, and three call sites still reach it including the one wired as a port

key_decisions.title: The always-succeeding stub became the specification, so a green suite says nothing about live
The SPEC is frozen: implement and ship all eight MSPs before proposing anything else
A built unit is dropped on resume, the defect M4 row 8 must fix
The run-4 dropped unit is an Integrate-to-Ship defect, not a resume defect
The closed dispatch-kind set is twelve, and scope-fence is not one of them
Two decoration deletions are withheld because they are the only bar on a billed spawn
A merge swallowed by a live base branch is recovered by cherry-pick, never by merging that branch
A local green counts only when produced where the guards can see the files
The remaining work closes the instrument and stops; no further discovery rounds
The recorder is fixed to see the planning phase before M8 spends money
M7 ships as an evidence document and changes no repository file
The M8 billed run proceeds without fixing the late crash-resume kill
Recorded cassettes fold onto the four kinds the replayer can actually route
No authored scenario describes what the real reviewer did

out_of_scope: Changing what the planner or reviewer models are asked to do; the four-of-four first-plan rejection rate measured on 2026-08-21 is filed as an observation, not fixed here
The ship-publish.mjs bypass of the dependency-injection seam, which M4 names as a limit of the sweep rather than repairing
Any engine change not required to make a failure observable, except the M4 row 8 resume fix, which is the worked example proving the instrument finds real defects
